title: Weather Plugin Configuration
description: Configuration schema for the Weather plugin - displays current conditions, hourly forecast, and daily forecast

enabled.description: Enable or disable the weather plugin

display_duration.description: How long to display each weather mode in seconds

update_interval.description: How often to fetch new weather data in seconds (minimum 300 = 5 minutes)

api_key.description: Deprecated — no longer used. Kept for backward compatibility with existing configs.
api_key.title: API Key (deprecated)

location_state.description: State or province name (optional but recommended for US cities to avoid ambiguity)
location_state.title: State/Province

location_country.description: Country code (e.g., US, GB, CA, FR). Use ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes.
location_country.title: Country Code

location_latitude.description: Optional. Exact latitude (-90 to 90). When both latitude and longitude are set, geocoding is skipped entirely.
location_latitude.title: Latitude (optional)

location_longitude.description: Optional. Exact longitude (-180 to 180). When both latitude and longitude are set, geocoding is skipped entirely.
location_longitude.title: Longitude (optional)

display_format.description: Display format for current weather. Supports placeholders: {temp}, {condition}, {humidity}, {wind}
display_format.title: Display Format

show_current_weather.description: Show current weather conditions with temperature, humidity, UV index, and wind
show_current_weather.title: Show Current Weather

show_hourly_forecast.description: Show hourly forecast for the next 24 hours
show_hourly_forecast.title: Show Hourly Forecast

show_daily_forecast.description: Show daily forecast for the next 3-7 days
show_daily_forecast.title: Show Daily Forecast

show_almanac.description: Show almanac display with sunrise/sunset, moon phase, and day length
show_almanac.title: Show Almanac

show_radar.description: Show precipitation radar imagery from RainViewer (free, no API key needed)
show_radar.title: Show Radar

show_alerts.description: Show weather alerts/warnings when active (takes priority in display rotation)
show_alerts.title: Show Weather Alerts

show_feels_like.description: Show feels-like temperature on current conditions (requires display height ≥48px)
show_feels_like.title: Show Feels Like

show_dew_point.description: Show dew point on current conditions (requires display height ≥48px)
show_dew_point.title: Show Dew Point

show_visibility.description: Show visibility distance on current conditions (requires display height ≥48px)
show_visibility.title: Show Visibility

show_pressure.description: Show barometric pressure on current conditions (requires display height ≥48px)
show_pressure.title: Show Pressure

radar_map_style.description: Basemap under the radar. Tile styles (osm/carto/carto_dark/esri) show real map detail worldwide and automatically fall back to the classic vector state-outline map when tiles are unavailable. 'vector' is the retro WeatherStar look (US-only).
radar_map_style.title: Radar Map Style

radar_range_miles.description: Distance from your location to the edge of the radar view, in miles. Replaces the old Radar Zoom Level setting.
radar_range_miles.title: Radar Range (miles)

radar_show_nowcast.description: Append ~30 minutes of predicted radar (RainViewer nowcast) after the observed frames, labeled 'FCST +10m' etc. with yellow progress dots.
radar_show_nowcast.title: Show Forecast Frames

radar_zoom.description: Deprecated — use Radar Range (miles) instead. Still honored when radar_range_miles is not set.
radar_zoom.title: Radar Zoom Level (deprecated)

radar_tile_server.description: Self-hosted OpenStreetMap tile server used for the 'osm' map style, expected to serve tiles at {server}/tile/{z}/{x}/{y}.png. Public OSM mirrors are used as fallback. Leave empty to use public mirrors only.
radar_tile_server.title: Radar Tile Server

radar_map_brightness.description: Brightness applied to the tile basemap so precipitation stands out on the LED matrix (1.0 = unchanged).
radar_map_brightness.title: Radar Map Brightness

radar_line_color.description: RGB color for state boundary lines on the vector map style (also used as the automatic fallback when tiles are unavailable). Default is green.
radar_line_color.title: Radar Map Line Color

radar_fill_color.description: RGB color for land fill on the vector map style. Use [0,0,0] for no fill (outlines only).
radar_fill_color.title: Radar Map Land Color

radar_update_interval.description: How often to check for new radar frames, in seconds. Checks are cheap — tiles are only downloaded when RainViewer publishes a new frame (roughly every 10 minutes).
radar_update_interval.title: Radar Update Interval

radar_past_frames.description: How many observed (past) radar frames to animate. RainViewer publishes one every ~10 minutes, so 6 frames = about an hour of history.
radar_past_frames.title: Radar Past Frames

radar_frame_seconds.description: Seconds each radar animation frame is shown.
radar_frame_seconds.title: Radar Frame Duration

radar_loop_pause_seconds.description: Extra hold on the newest frame before the animation loops.
radar_loop_pause_seconds.title: Radar Loop Pause

dynamic_duration.title: Dynamic Duration (radar)
dynamic_duration.description: When enabled, the rotation holds the radar mode until its animation completes a full loop (up to the cap) instead of the fixed display duration.
